lines.en: I drag this leg forward.
My shoulder won't do what I ask.
One shoulder rides higher than the other.
I reach up and touch my neck.
I do not look at the road.
I walk more steadily as I go.
My joints click.
I gradually angled a different way.
I am getting used to this leg.
I walk along the wall.
I stop, take a breath, and walk on.
My step is heavier than yesterday's.
The light makes me squint.
Step by step, without stopping.
I walk on my shadow.
I walk slowly away.
I stand, my head slightly tilted.
I watch my fingertips harden.
Something moves under my skin.
I breathe, breath after breath.
I know I am changing.
This does not hurt at all.

lines.zh: 我抬起手臂，看了一会儿。
lines.en: I raise an arm and look at it.
I want to speak. My throat tightens.
I hear my own bones.
Time is pushing me along.

lines.zh: 我眨了下眼，确认还看得见。
lines.en: I blink to make sure I still see.
I remember how I looked yesterday.
I close my fist slowly.
I am waiting for the next change.
I stand and listen to my bones.
My shadow is taller than I am.
You can see it too, can you not.
I am turning into something else.
I hold up my hand for you.
This is not a wound.
I still speak slowly.
Step into the light. Let me see you.
I still recognise myself.
You look exactly the same.
I am a little envious.
For now I will not hurt you.
Do not stare.
I have not reached that stage yet.

lines.zh: 我咬牙忍着，变异在血里烧。
lines.en: I grit my teeth as mutation burns in my blood.
I grip my arm until the pain passes.
The blood is red, at least.
I brace on my knee and rise slowly.
I swallowed.
I step back, and my heels feel weak.
This is easier to bear than the change.
I can still stand.
I push my sleeve up and look.
I open my mouth, and nothing comes out.
I can still eat.
Give this to me.
My hands are a little unsteady.
Everything tastes stronger than yesterday.
Leave it on the table.
I slow my hand as much as I can.
I reach for it slowly.
I cannot bite through this.
Thank you truly.
I still remember how to eat.
My hands will not quite obey.
This taste is very strong.
I will keep it for later.
I still remember how to hold it.
Don't hand it over. I'll take it.
I smell something else.
I bump into you and hurry back.
My body has gone a little hard.
I hit you, and I panic worse than you.
I pull my hand back quickly.
The bones knocked loudly.
I said sorry.
I steady and turn slowly.
I did not intend to hurt anyone.
Do not be afraid.
Let me pass.
Stand back. I might touch you.

lines.zh: 我不知道下一步会怎样。
lines.en: I do not know what the next step brings.
Can you still talk to me.
I will try to go slowly.
Remember how I look now.
This is not your fault.
Keep some distance.
I do not have much time.
Go while I still know you.
Thank you for coming.
I pick it up and study it.
My hand does not quite obey.
I nearly dropped it.
Can this be eaten.
I put it in my pocket.
My sweat is on it.
I cannot grip it.
I lift it, then set it gently back.
This object is of no use.
I put it away slowly.

lines.zh: 你的影子往我这边挪了。
lines.en: Your shadow slid toward me.
I raise my face.
My head turns toward you by itself.
My body moved on its own.
I'm coming at you. Nothing stops it.
I don't want to go, but my feet walk.
I did not choose this step.
I cannot stop my feet.
There is not far between us.
My hand lifts without asking me.
I walk toward you step by step.
I am trying to slow down.
My steps grow heavier.
You are backing away.
I lift my hand and let it fall.
Something inside is pushing.
I am counting my steps.
One more step and I will stop.
I hear my own breathing.
This body does not obey me.
My hand struck out.
I pulled the blow. Too late.
My hand moved first. Not me.
My hand closed before I noticed.
My whole body is shaking.
That wasn't my strength.
I have let go.
I jerk my hand back.
You are not badly hurt?
I cannot speak now.

lines.zh: 一个人站在那儿，姿势很怪。
lines.en: A person stands there, holding himself oddly.
I prop myself up bit by bit.

lines.zh: 我站直时，脊背咔了一下。
lines.en: My spine clicks as I straighten up.
My shadow is longer than yesterday.

lines.zh: 我把手掌翻过来，看了看。
lines.en: I turn my palm over and stare at it.
I know I am changing.
The wind made me shiver.
I'm still standing. Still breathing.
This step is mine.
I take a few steps and stop.
Fire caught my skin, and I beat it out.
I landed hard, and my bones rang.
Water got in my lungs, and I coughed hard.

lines.zh: 炸响把我掀倒，耳朵发闷。
lines.en: The blast knocks me down and my ears go dull.
Something sank into my shoulder.
This light hastens the change.
Hungry, the change slows.
After the lightning, my hands tremble.
There is no ground here.
